reddit.title: Introducing New Mechanics for Ranks in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how units move and attack in Provincia. Now, when you drag a formation, it will face the direction you pull, ensuring a more intuitive experience. No more teleporting soldiers or awkward movements! Learn more about these changes and how they impact gameplay here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: Revamped Unit Movement Mechanics in Provincia
steam.body: We’re excited to share our latest updates on unit mechanics! The new system allows for more realistic movements, where soldiers slide into formation without teleporting. This change enhances strategic gameplay and makes battles feel more authentic. Read the full details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
